exercises.title: Slide check: validating props with PropTypes
exercises.problemHtml:
Eight questions on Slot 13 — PropTypes validators, required props and default values.

Tip: read every option before choosing — the wrong options are real mistakes students make in the FE exam.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All questions must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Slide check: validating props with PropTypes — answer key

1. What happens when a prop fails its PropTypes check in development?
   Answer: b) A warning is printed in the console; rendering continues
   PropTypes only warns (and only in development builds). / PropTypes chỉ cảnh báo (và chỉ ở bản development).

2. Correct declaration?
   Answer: b) Card.propTypes = { title: PropTypes.string }
   Static property propTypes, values from the PropTypes library. / Thuộc tính tĩnh propTypes, giá trị lấy từ thư viện PropTypes.

3. Validate an array of numbers:
   Answer: b) PropTypes.arrayOf(PropTypes.number)
   arrayOf checks every element. / arrayOf kiểm từng phần tử.

4. An object with known keys is validated with…
   Answer: b) PropTypes.shape({ … })
   shape describes each key; exact() also rejects extra keys. / shape mô tả từng khoá; exact() còn từ chối khoá thừa.

5. Allow only "primary", "secondary" or "danger":
   Answer: a) PropTypes.oneOf(['primary', 'secondary', 'danger'])
   oneOf = one of these values; oneOfType = one of these types. / oneOf = một trong các giá trị; oneOfType = một trong các kiểu.

6. Make a prop mandatory:
   Answer: a) add .isRequired
   e.g. PropTypes.string.isRequired. / vd PropTypes.string.isRequired.

7. A custom validator should…
   Answer: b) return an Error when invalid, null otherwise
   Signature (props, propName, componentName) => Error | null. / Dạng (props, propName, componentName) => Error | null.

8. Modern way to give a function component a default prop value?
   Answer: b) Default value in the destructured parameter: ({ size = 'md' })
   defaultProps on function components is deprecated (removed in React 19). / defaultProps cho function component đã bị khuyến cáo bỏ (React 19 bỏ hẳn).
